component_instructions.inputs: Must use FlowDesk standard: h-8, text-sm, px-3, py-1. Add 'form-dense' classes where applicable.
component_instructions.buttons: Must use FlowDesk standard: h-8, text-sm. Primary for main actions, outline/ghost for secondary.
component_instructions.stepper: Design a custom horizontal stepper using flexbox and lucide-vue-next icons. Active step gets primary color treatment, completed gets subtle success or primary outline, upcoming gets muted.
component_instructions.info_card: Inside the left sidebar Card, use a `grid-cols-2` layout for Key-Value pairs. Stack them tightly: Label (text-xs uppercase) directly above Value (text-sm font-semibold).
component_instructions.status_badge: Use px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold border for prominent application statuses (DIAJUKAN, etc).
component_instructions.form_grouping: Group related fields in `/loan-simulation/{id}` using inner containers with subtle borders (`border-border/40`) and soft background (`bg-muted/20`) to break up dense forms. Add an inner header to each group.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Redesign `/loan-simulation/create`: Build a focused, linear card flow. Top section for KTP Check (Input + Button side-by-side). Add a loading state for the Cek KTP button.

2. On `/loan-simulation/create`: If KTP is found, display the 'Info Nasabah' inside a read-only well (bg-muted/30) using a 2-column grid. Emphasize 'Data dari sistem lain' using a subtle info alert. Bottom section for Plafon & Jangka Waktu inputs.

3. Redesign `/loan-simulation/{id}` - Header: Create a prominent top header containing the Title (Kode Pengajuan with monospace font), Status Badge (using semantic colors defined in JSON), and primary global actions.

4. Redesign `/loan-simulation/{id}` - Stepper: Replace standard tabs with a visual horizontal stepper (Pengajuan -> Jaminan -> Surveyor -> Konfirmasi) placed right below the header. This gives a professional 'wizard' feel.
5. Redesign `/loan-simulation/{id}` - Layout Proportions: Update the grid to 12 columns. Left column (Info Nasabah) gets 4 cols (33.3%), Right column gets 8 cols (66.6%). This balances the page.
6. Redesign `/loan-simulation/{id}` - Left Column: Fix the 'long vertical list' issue by placing the info into a dense `grid-cols-2` block. Group logical data together (Identity vs Financials).

7. Redesign `/loan-simulation/{id}` - Right Column (Form Area): Do not leave the 15-field form as raw inputs. Segment them into visually distinct blocks (e.g., 'Informasi Dasar', 'Parameter Kredit') using bordered wrappers.

8. Ensure all typography enforces a strict hierarchy: labels must use the defined 'label' style (text-xs text-muted-foreground uppercase), values use 'value' (text-sm font-semibold text-foreground). Stop using text-xs for everything.
9. Maintain the 'compact UI' constraint: Ensure every Input, Select, and Button uses h-8. Do not inflate component sizes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements like buttons and inputs.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not disrupt the natural reading flow.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from shadcn-vue in /app/adminkit/resources/js/components/ui/.
All inputs, selects, DatePickers, NumberInputs, and buttons MUST strictly follow the 32px height constraint (h-8) to maintain the FlowDesk 'compact UI' concept.
DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for headers, overlays, or dropdown menus. Use solid bg-card or bg-background to prevent overlapping text.

Ensure high contrast and readability in both light and dark modes by sticking to shadcn CSS variables (bg-card, text-foreground, text-muted-foreground, etc.). Do NOT invent new hardcoded colors outside of status accents.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='cek-ktp-btn') for robust automated testing.
